correctness.rationale: The Petersen-supported permutation bijection and cycle-complement analysis prove the complete 6+24+30 classification. A relative-permutation single-cycle lemma is proved for legal flips. Two independently written complete exact checkers, one using 60 supported permutations and one using 30-edge GP(10,3) masks with an explicit graph isomorphism, enumerate all 1770 unordered pairs and independently verify components, degrees, double-K6 incidence, and 60-source distances. A separate Ryser inclusion-exclusion permanent evaluates to 60 exactly, independently of both recursive matching enumerations. No finite-to-infinite extrapolation is asserted.
